summary: OpenAI published an open-source specification called Symphony for orchestrating Codex agents to turn issue trackers into continuously running agent systems.

mechanisms.reason: The spec describes agents autonomously working from issue trackers as always-on systems, a form of tool-using agentic workflow replacing manual engineering tasks.
mechanisms.quote: turns issue trackers into always-on agent systems—boosting engineering output and reducing context switching

mechanisms.reason: Always-on agent systems imply continuous, higher-frequency model calls compared to interactive human-triggered usage.
